output.summary: Arts' resolution gap is mostly explained by two process effects, not bias against Arts. SlotBook tickets go to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17 and wait a median of 17 days before first action. Lindqvist's twice-weekly on-site cover delays hardware tickets. Matched on category and priority, Arts is within 0.3 days of other faculties, and its duplicate and how-to rates are normal. Volume is not fully explained by SlotBook, since non-SlotBook volume is still 1.6x average. The acknowledgement email hides best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished. The SSO link to the SlotBook ticket rise is confounded. Recommend clarifying SlotBook's support status and fixing the acknowledgement, with monitoring. Hold the FTE transfer, the blanket P4 proposal and the forced CampusBook migration.
